attchmntText: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has intimated the schedule for investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. On December 2, 2026, Ambit Capital will hold an in-person one-on-one and group meeting during the Annual Travel Ecosystem conference starting at 10:00 AM. The schedule is tentative and may be modified, rescheduled, or canceled due to unforeseen circumstances or business exigencies.

attchmntText: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Advertisement - Loss of share certificate(s)
voiceSummary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has published a newspaper advertisement regarding the proposed issue of duplicate securities. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The advertisement addresses the loss of securities as per SEBI circular dated December 24, 2025. The notice was published in the Financial Express and Loksatta on November 27, 2026. The information is also available on the company website at www.ihctata.com. Melisa Alva, Senior Vice President and Company Secretary, signed the communication.

attchmntText: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of Newspaper advertisement regarding the special window for re-lodgement of transfer request of physical shares.
voiceSummary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has published a newspaper advertisement in Financial Express and Loksatta on November 26, 2026. This disclosure is under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The advertisement concerns a special window for the re-lodgement of transfer requests for physical shares. The information is also available on the company website at www.ihctata.com. Melisa Alva, Senior Vice President and Company Secretary, signed the letter. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
